jobs.title: Legal Council
jobs.description: Join SE3 Labs as Legal Counsel Own SE3's legal work and help the company negotiate, decide and move quickly in a demanding regulatory field. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Legal function , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. About the Role As Legal Counsel, you'll own SE3's legal work, from negotiating commercial contracts to building the legal processes we need as we grow. You'll work closely with our founders in Munich and coordinate specialist external counsel on export, procurement and international questions. This can be your first role leading a legal function. What You'll Work On Contract Negotiation: Negotiate commercial contracts and help the team close them quickly. Corporate & Employment: Coordinate advice on corporate and employment matters. Export & Procurement: Work with specialist external counsel on export control, government procurement and international questions. Legal Processes: Build clear, practical legal processes that help the team make decisions. Advising the Team: Explain legal trade-offs clearly so the founders and teams can act. Your Profile You take ownership of outcomes and remove obstacles without waiting for direction. You turn discussions into clear decisions and decisions into deliverables, and you hold yourself and your team to a consistently high standard. You bring strong legal experience and practical commercial judgement. jobs.title: Data Privacy Compliance Specialist
jobs.description: The Data Privacy Compliance Specialist supports DeepHealth's global data privacy programs, including HIPAA and GDPR. Reporting to the Data Privacy Compliance Lead, this role collaborates across the organization to help ensure personal data is collected, processed, and stored in line with applicable privacy laws and DeepHealth requirements. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Support organizational data privacy efforts and help ensure compliance with applicable local, national, and global privacy laws and regulations. Assist with the Privacy by Design program supporting product development and modification, including software and AI use cases. Collaborate with Vendor Management on vendor qualification and on implementation of Data Processing Agreements and Transfer Impact Assessments as applicable. Research and review country-specific data privacy frameworks and regulations to support continued compliance and business opportunities. Collaborate cross-functionally to implement technical and organizational measures that support data privacy. Monitor how personal data is collected, processed, and stored for compliance with applicable laws. Participate in investigations and impact assessments related to information security events with privacy implications. Serve as a backup point of contact for data protection authorities and data subjects, handling inquiries and requests. Collaborate cross-functionally to improve data privacy processes in support of risk management frameworks such as GDPR and HIPAA. Maintain clear documentation of privacy activities and support audit and regulatory readiness as assigned. Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience (required). Minimum of 2 years of experience in a regulated industry (required); medical device experience preferred. Software and/or Software as a Medical Device experience preferred. jobs.title: Director, Legal - Employment
jobs.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role This position is remote and based in the United Kingdom or Ireland. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports at this time. You'll own matters end to end rather than manage a team. As Director, Legal – Employment, you will own GitLab’s matters spanning the full employment relationship in EMEA, from recruiting and onboarding through compensation, performance, leave management, separation, and, when necessary, litigation. You will independently lead complex employment law matters end-to-end, including representing GitLab before works councils and labor courts, as well as setting the strategy

jobs.title: Consultant (m/w/d) Sicherheit, Compliance & Business Alignment
jobs.description: Der Mittelstand steht vor einer der größten Veränderungsphasen der letzten Jahre: NIS2, ISO 27001, AI Act, Lieferkettenanforderungen und steigende Haftungsregeln. Viele Unternehmen fühlen sich damit überfordert und genau hier kommt VIAMA ins Spiel. Wir geben Unternehmen Orientierung, Klarheit und Sicherheit in 30 Tagen . Und dafür suchen wir engagierte Talente , die Struktur lieben, schnell Verantwortung übernehmen wollen und Freude daran haben, Komplexität verständlich zu machen. Wenn du lieber wirkst statt nur PowerPoint zu bauen, wenn du gerne mitdenkst, priorisierst und Unternehmen sicherer machst, dann bist du bei uns richtig. Aufgaben Struktur bringen: Analyse von Risiken, Prozessen und Sicherheitsanforderungen Aufbereitung klarer Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Führungsteams Mitarbeit an NIS2- und ISO-Projekten Umsetzung gestalten: Unterstützung in Workshops und Gesprächen mit Kunden Erarbeiten von Maßnahmenplänen, Prioritäten und Empfehlungen Mitarbeit beim Aufbau unserer TrustOS-Frameworks Kommunikation & Klarheit: Übersetzen von Fachthemen in einfache, verständliche Sprache Erstellen von Unterlagen für Management und Teams Dokumentation, Steuerung, Follow-ups Projektarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Consultants Verantwortung für eigene Arbeitspakete Schrittweise Übernahme kleinerer Teilprojekte Qualifikation Must-haves: Neugier und echtes Interesse an Sicherheit, Compliance, Organisation oder IT Freude an Struktur, Klarheit und Priorisierung Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation Eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit Lust auf Lernen, Verantwortung und direkte Kundennähe Nice-to-have: Erste Erfahrungen in Beratung, Sicherheit, Compliance, Audit oder Projektmanagement Kenntnisse zu NIS2, ISO 27001 oder Datenschutz (kein Muss!) Erfahrung mit Mittelstand, Vereinen, studentischen Initiativen oder Projekten Du passt perfekt, wenn du: schnell lernst dich gut organisieren kannst gerne Probleme löst keine Angst vor Verantwortung hast nicht auf

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. jobs.title: DevSecOps Lead
jobs.description: General Responsibilities: The DevSecOps Lead is responsible for leading the integration of robust security practices into our DevOps pipeline, ensuring the protection and compliance of our cloud infrastructure. This role demands a strategic mindset to optimize system performance and reliability while fostering a culture of security within the organization. Duties and Responsibilities: Cloud Infrastructure Management: Lead the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure Monitor and optimize cloud resource usage and performance, making strategic improvement recommendations. Security Integration: Develop and implement advanced security practices within the DevOps lifecycle. Conduct regular security assessments, vulnerability scanning, and penetration testing. Implement and manage robust security controls, policies, and procedures. Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate and secure deployment processes. Ensure integration of advanced security checks within the CI/CD pipelines. Compliance and Governance: Ensure adherence to industry regulations (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) and internal compliance standards. Implement and manage comprehensive compliance monitoring tools and frameworks. Prepare and maintain detailed documentation for audits and compliance requirements. Monitoring and Incident Response: Implement and manage sophisticated monitoring tools for cloud infrastructure and applications. Develop and maintain incident response plans and procedures. Lead complex incident response activities, including root cause analysis and comprehensive remediation. Collaboration and Leadership: Foster a collaborative environment by working closely with development, operations, and security teams.
